**[Ave Maria](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=k-8KNIe3VeE)** <br>
Latin source: Traditional

Ave Maria, gratia plena<br>
Dominus tecum;<br>
Benedicta tu in mulieribus,<br>
et benedictus fructus ventris tui, Jesus.<br>
Sancta Maria, Mater Dei,<br>
ora pro nobis peccatoribus,<br>
nunc et in hora mortis nostrae.<br>
Amen.

**Hail Mary** <br>
English translation: Traditional

Hail Mary, full of grace,<br>
The Lord is with thee;<br>
Blessed art thou amongst women,<br>
And blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus.<br>
Holy Mary, Mother of God,<br>
Pray for us sinners,<br>
Now and at the hour of our death.<br>
Amen.
